svg.title: Coast Garibaldi Health — symbol and wordmark (vector reconstruction)
svg.desc: Reconstruction of the Coast Garibaldi Community Health Services Society logo. Disc, bars and ridge/sun lines are geometry fitted to the 765 x 246 px bitmap in the June 2000 Word header preserved on cghealth.org; the name is set in Gelasio Bold Italic (SIL OFL) and converted to outlines as a stand-in for the unverified original typeface. Colours approximated from the 2001 website GIF.
